But most especially, this book is for Elizabeth. ACKNOWLEDGMENTS T his book came out of my own struggles with procrastination, motivation, and creativity, but in large part it is based on the experiences of thousands of coaching and therapy clients and seminar participants who have shared their difficulties and their triumphs with me.
